subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept this exact grouped set of action revisions in workflows that handle credentials, publishing, security scanning, and Codex execution?
rationale: The revisions are plausible and no concrete defect was found, but CI cannot decide whether maintainers accept the changed third-party execution boundary for secrets and release automation.

options.title: Approve stable exact head
options.body: Accept the grouped update after official-pin verification, completed required checks, and security/release owner approval on one unchanged SHA.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Separate token, publishing, CodeQL, and Codex-agent actions into narrower PRs for independent trust-boundary review.

options.title: Pause the bundle
options.body: Defer or close the grouped update if Dependabot cannot produce a stable accessible head for validation.

recommendation.title: Approve stable exact head
recommendation.body: Accept the grouped update after official-pin verification, completed required checks, and security/release owner approval on one unchanged SHA.

likelyOwner.reason: History connects this person to action-runtime modernization, Docker release automation, and the Codex-agent workflow, and the PR timeline explicitly routed the review to them.
